resolutions.action: option A, the direction of both halves (codex's matching warning is closed by this entry): checkStoredSignoff now makes every check the write gate makes on the record it writes — timestamp present, model present and a string or null, change equal to the change, no kind, final_assessment or next_recommended, and no key the gate never writes — beside command, sha256 and the payload fields.
